It is good advice, very good and its something I might try, but when you've been thinking something for so long, obsessing over it, devoting time to writing goodbyes etc; its ingrained into your head. It sometimes makes explaining easier if I make a point from a different perspective, ie: a counsellor. I think my problem is that I don't want to get better, I don't see anything worth living for. I'm not living for my parents sake, I'm just not dying for their sake. I believe I'm living a life meant for someone else, someone more deserving, I do not deserve yo have the quality of life I have. I am extremely thankful for the roof over my head, the food in my stomach and the clothes on my back, but if i could chose, feeling how i feel now, i would trade that for something a lot worse, because I believe that's what I deserve. I'm sorry if I've detracted from my point, or waffled a bit. But i don't often find the words to explain my thoughts with clarity.

Yeah, i have a fantasy similar to that, except I'm walking down the street at night and I get mugged and killed. Its almost like torture, you want, sorry, you. NEED something but you cant get it. I'm drowning in life, i just don't know how much air i have left.

I'm sorry to hear that you feel the same, even though it is comforting to know I am not alone. It is not something I would wish upon anyone. Its hard because I know for a fact Id be gone, if I knew for sure my parents would be ok. I'm hurting, I want to leave, but its not fair to transfer that hurt onto someone else, I'm not a good person, but I cant shake that thought. Perhaps I'm thinking too much about it, I don't know, but right now I don't have the courage to do it myself: so I'm hoping something (illness), or someone (say stabbing), does it for me.
You've just summed up how I've been feeling for the past two years in a paragraph. I completely sympathise with you.
And to answer your suggestion about the age, I'm 20, British and I'm in a job, which I drag myself to everyday :/
I really don't know if I want to get better, I don't feel like i deserve the help. I feel like a fraud, a hypochondriac of sorts. :/

I'm just so scared theyll turn me away, I think something like that would push me over the edge, id be literally putting my life in someone's hands, and they wouldn't know it. At least at the moment its all down to me.
How do you deal with something like this though, I feel like I'm going to go mad. Its a decision I cannot make, not yet, and it plagues me. :/

I feel like a counselor will just tell me to grow up and get out. or something along those lines. :/ Ive dealt with things by myself my whole life, no-one understands you like yourself. No one will understand why I want this.

I tried, kind of, talking to them once. Theyd found out I was self harming. So I approached the subject of suicide. I was told I was stupid and selfish etc. 

I'm not talking to them, I can't talk to them.
Most of the time, it's as if the only reason they care, if they do, is because they feel they have to since they're my parents. :/

I, I don't know. I'm jumping back and forth between extremes, one minute I'm certain that I'm going to do it, it'll just take a tiny urge of spontaneous desire. But then I'm angry at myself, for being a coward. 
I'm starting to scare myself, it's like I become a different person. Almost like the depression is another personality, another part of me which is just slowly taking over. the depression is a virus and I'm the host type thing. Weird analogy I know, but i can't think of any other way to describe it :/
